about.label: About
about.title: Delivering the <highlight1>Finest</highlight1> Gift Boxes for Your <highlight2>Special</highlight2> Moments
about.description: Make every moment memorable with our premium gift boxes. Carefully curated and beautifully packaged, each box is filled with handpicked items designed to impress.

items.jakeReview: I've been ordering from this flower shop for years and they never disappoint. The quality and service are exceptional!
items.tylerReview: Customer service is top-notch and the flowers last longer than any others I've bought. Highly recommend!
items.maxReview: The team truly cares about every order. I always feel confident when I buy flowers from here.
items.sophiaReview: Absolutely beautiful flowers and amazing attention to detail. Every arrangement feels special and unique!
items.danielReview: The flowers arrived fresh and beautifully arranged. Great experience from ordering to delivery!
items.emmaReview: Wonderful service and stunning bouquets. This shop has become my favorite place for flowers.

bestSelling.title: <accent>Check Out</accent> What Everyone's <accent>Buying</accent> Right Now
bestSelling.description: Not sure what to choose? Start with our best sellers—these are the gifts our customers keep coming back for. Whether you're celebrating a birthday, anniversary, or wedding, our top picks are guaranteed to leave a lasting impression.

about.title: About Us
about.heroDescription: Rose began with a simple belief: the right gift, presented beautifully, says what words cannot. Every box we send is assembled by hand, checked twice, and delivered with the care we would want for our own family.

imageAlt.main: Our team arranging a gift box
imageAlt.detail: Close-up of a finished gift box

values.title: The Promises Behind Every Box
values.description: We keep our standards simple and hold ourselves to them on every single order, whether it is your first or your fiftieth.

thoughtful.title: Thoughtful by Design
thoughtful.description: Each collection is curated around a real moment, so what arrives feels chosen rather than picked off a shelf.

quality.title: Quality You Can Feel
quality.description: We work with makers we trust and inspect every item before it is wrapped, because a gift is only as good as its contents.

lasting.title: Kind to the Planet
lasting.description: Recyclable packaging, responsibly sourced materials, and no filler waste — thoughtful gifting should not cost the earth.

cta.title: Have Something Special in Mind?
cta.description: Tell us about the occasion and we will help you put together a gift that fits it perfectly.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.eyebrow: We would love to hear from you
contact.description: Questions about an order, a bulk request, or just an idea you want help shaping? Reach out and a real person will get back to you.

details.title: Get in Touch
details.description: Pick whichever way is easiest — we answer all of them.
